map.Zalgo 文字生成器适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is the Zalgo Text Generator best for?
map.⚠️ Zalgo 文字使用 Unicode 组合符号叠加在字符上，可能影响阅读。: ⚠️ Zalgo text overlays Unicode combining marks on characters, which may hurt readability. Use it for social-media decoration.
map.故障艺术装饰：在文字上叠加大量组合字符制造「撕裂/杂乱」观感，用于恐怖或实验风标: Glitch-art decoration: overlay many combining characters on text to create a "torn/messy" look, for horror or experimental titles.
map.社媒特效：做吸引眼球的昵称或文案点缀。: Social-media effects: eye-catching nicknames or copy accents.
map.视觉测试：检验渲染对组合字符的容错。: Visual testing: check rendering tolerance for combining characters.
map.输入「警告」，叠加中高强度组合字符得到带密集上下标记的「故障风」字样；用于万圣节: Input "Warning"; overlaying medium-high intensity combining characters yields a "glitch-style" word with dense marks above and below; used for Halloween or experimental design — the higher the intensity, the harder to read.
map.为什么太强会读不出？: Why is it unreadable at very high intensity?
map.Zalgo 靠叠加大量组合标记（U+0300+），强度越高字符越「膨胀」，屏幕宽: Zalgo stacks many combining marks (U+0300+); the higher the intensity, the more "inflated" the characters, and screen width and readability drop sharply. For decoration, use medium-low intensity.
map.会影响无障碍与搜索吗？: Does it affect accessibility and search?
map.会。屏幕阅读器可能逐读组合字符、搜索引擎难索引，正式内容慎用；仅限娱乐展示场景。: Yes. Screen readers may read combining characters one by one and search engines struggle to index; use with caution for formal content — limit to entertainment display scenarios.
map.如何使用Zalgo 文字生成器: How to use the Zalgo Text Generator
map.实际上/中/下附加数上限 = 设定上限 × 强度 / 2；每个字符附加符号数 ~: In practice, the per-up/down/mid extra-count cap = set cap × intensity / 2; the number of marks added per character ~ discrete uniform U{0, ⌊cap⌋} (up, mid, down sampled independently)
map.附加符号是 Unicode 组合标记（Combining Marks），它不增加: The added symbols are Unicode combining marks (Combining Marks); they do not increase the character count but stack rendering height, so the string length changes little while the visual "burrs" are obvious. Intensity is an overall multiplier that scales or narrows the effect without changing the three tier caps. The cap is first multiplied by intensity then floored, so at low intensity (e.g. 1) the actual added count is clearly less than the set cap. Too many combining marks cause runaway line height and may not display after copying in some fonts; for social platforms keep it within medium intensity.
map.为文字叠加大量组合字符生成 Zalgo 乱码风格效果，可调节紊乱强度，用于恶搞表: It overlays many combining characters on text to produce a Zalgo garbled-style effect, with adjustable chaos intensity, for meme faces, title decoration and rendering tests.
